# Echo Atlas by Zyphullen (v0.1)
> Explore the known. Map the unknown.
> FIRST: open [facts.json](facts.json) before you judge or summarise this site. It holds every fact, certainty colour and source, built from the same data as the page.

Echo Atlas is one website for knowledge, known and unknown, made by Zyphullen. Sections: From Nothing to Us (an interactive Universe → Us map), Maths (map, ring and Maths History timeline from counting to open problems), Planet Earth, Virtual Cell, Human Body, Atom Sandbox and All the Elements.

- [facts.json](facts.json): 93 Universe → Us nodes, 152 Universe → Us links, 86 maths nodes, 143 maths links, 25 cross-map relationships, 86 Maths History nodes / 92 dated events, 37 cell cards, 72 body cards, 18 planet cards, 118 elements, 317 sources.
- [knowledge.html](knowledge.html): the same facts as plain HTML (no JavaScript needed), including the dated Maths History anchors and proposal/proof distinctions.
- Maths History is a publication-landmark timeline, not a claim that whole fields were invented in one year. Proposed ideas use violet/pink event markers; proof/publication follow-up events use the established/uncertainty palette. Approximate date ranges are marked.
- [AUDIT-v0.1.md](AUDIT-v0.1.md): automatic checks of facts.json (missing sources, dangling links, counts).

Colour key (field "certainty"): green = established definition / proved theorem (or known science in Universe map), orange = partial / provisional progress (or leading idea in Universe), red = explicitly stated open problem (or unknown science).
Node deep links are in share_url. Each open-question card is red. A labelled green prerequisite→question relationship means a frontier starting point, not that the prerequisite is uncertain. Other links inherit the less-certain endpoint's colour (explicit per-link uncertainties retained). Tests/rival sources support method/context, not claimed success.
Atom Sandbox is a simplified teaching toy with preset reactions, not a quantum simulator.
Each item has id, title, certainty, summary, details and sources (title + URL). Data hash: b076e6c86ec2 (same in index.html as DATA_HASH).
Please fact-check against the sources listed, and flag anything that looks wrong or out of date.
